CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_ortho_strategy_revision_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Same ownership-only exception as medical history; never edit clinical facts,
  -- recorded provenance, command identity, revision lineage or fixed case IDs.
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'patient_id') = (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'patient_id') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Orthodontic strategy revisions are append-only'
    USING ERRCODE = '55000';
END;
$function$
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ortho_strategy_case_identity_unique ON public.ortho_strategy_revisions USING btree (ortho_case_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ortho_strategy_case_version_unique ON public.ortho_strategy_revisions USING btree (ortho_case_id, version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ortho_strategy_command_unique ON public.ortho_strategy_revisions USING btree (ortho_case_id, actor_user_id, command_id)
CREATE INDEX ortho_strategy_patient_case_version_idx ON public.ortho_strategy_revisions USING btree (patient_id, ortho_case_id, version DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ortho_strategy_revisions_pkey ON public.ortho_strategy_revisions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ortho_strategy_successor_unique ON public.ortho_strategy_revisions USING btree (supersedes_revision_id)

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "RI_ConstraintTrigger_a_ID" AFTER UPDATE ON public.clinical_cases FROM ortho_strategy_revisions NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "RI_FKey_noaction_upd"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_log_is_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      BEGIN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'سجل التدقيق لا يُعدَّل ولا يُحذف منه.';
      END;
      $function$
CREATE INDEX audit_log_action_idx ON public.audit_log USING btree (action, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_entity_idx ON public.audit_log USING btree (entity, entity_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_log_pkey ON public.audit_log USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_time_idx ON public.audit_log USING btree (created_at DESC)
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON public.audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_log_is_append_only()
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON public.audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_log_is_append_only()
